## Descripción
A message has been encrypted using RSA. The public key is gone… but someone might have been careless with the private key. Can you recover it and decrypt the message? Download the [flag](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/4c19613e66e3f22baabf929555a826f8ebd997a002b008eb4e51dc2849aca14e/flag.enc) and [image](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/4c19613e66e3f22baabf929555a826f8ebd997a002b008eb4e51dc2849aca14e/image.jpg).

1.- Metadata can tell you more than you expect.

2.- Hex can be turned back into a key file.

aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ exiftool -Comment image.jpg
Comment                         : 
aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ exiftool -s3 -Comment image.jpg > clave_hex.txt
aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ xxd -r -p clave_hex.txt > privada.pem
aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ head -n 1 privada.pem
-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ openssl pkey -in privada.pem -check -noout
Key is valid
aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey privada.pem -in flag.enc -pkeyopt rsa_padding_mode:pkcs1 -out flag.txt
aaron-tank_3@aaron-tankVirtualBox:~/picoctf-crypto/03-stegorsa$ cat flag.txt
academy{rs4_k3y_1n_1mg_9db27b2c}

## Notas Adicionales
- La clave privada completa está filtrada en los metadatos. Recuperarla permite descifrar el archivo directamente.
